standard_prerequisites.use: Base-change stability of the listed properties, sheaves of differentials, and finite order thickenings; the converse direction is retained, not cited.

core_obligations: Discharge the forward direction by base-change stability of the eleven listed properties.
Prove the converse for each property, including the differential criterion, and finish the immersion cases by factoring through the open subscheme of S' with the same underlying space.

proof_roadmap.step: Record that the listed properties are stable under base change so that f inherits them from f'.
Prove the converse property by property, reducing each from the thickening back to the base.
Finish the closed immersion and immersion cases using the open subscheme of S' with the same underlying space.

difficulty_reason: For a morphism of thickenings (f, f') : (X in X') -> (S in S') with X = S x_{S'} X' over a finite order thickening S in S', eleven properties are shown to hold for f exactly when they hold for f'. The proof first discharges the forward direction as a base-change citation list, then treats the converse case by case, using the differential comparison Omega_{X/S} = 0 iff Omega_{X'/S'} = 0 and finishing the closed immersion and immersion items by factoring through an open subscheme of S' with the same underlying topological space. The reduction of each property from the thickening back to the base is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 357-474.
